name: herdr-sibling-panels
description: Interactive sibling panels in caller workspace/tab: Agy Gemini 3.8 Flash (High effort) builder and validator. Designed for Herdr current-pane placement.

agents.name: gemini-builder
agents.task: Own implementation edits and focused regression tests. Produce concrete diffs and verified test results.

agents.name: gemini-validator
agents.task: Run targeted validation and adversarial checks. Verify edge cases and report concrete findings.

notes: Uses placement: current-pane automatically when invoked inside Herdr (HERDR_ENV=1).
Spawns native agy with --model gemini-3.8-flash-high --effort high --dangerously-skip-permissions.
Panels are split directly in the caller's active tab without focusing away or creating an isolated daemon.
